Would the people around you say you keep your word,
even when it costs you?
Psalm 15 asks God a question:
Lord, who can stay in your tent?
Who can live on your holy hill?
The word for stay is the Hebrew GOOR:
to live somewhere as a guest.
Who gets to be God's guest?
The answer reads like a portrait.
Someone who walks with integrity
and speaks truth from the heart.
Who doesn't slander.
Who keeps a promise even when it hurts.
Who won't take a bribe against the innocent.
And it ends with a promise:
whoever does these things will never be shaken.
So today,
keep one promise you'd rather break.
Keep your word.
Stand unshaken.
